source: intake_court_20260803 — six independent courts; per feedback_codify_agent_dd_feedback these are WIRED-WORK-OWED, not notes
euronext_shelf.py: P1 PENSION GUARD: net-cash/EV math omits IAS-19 obligations (SFPI EUR50.6M -> 39% net cash was really 12-18%; EV/EBIT 4.5x really 6.0-6.5x). Pull provisions/pension from the same filing pass; flag pension>10% of mktcap.
P1 ibkr_verified is conid-existence, NOT executability: require live bid/ask with is_close=false else DATA_GATED (PRIC-B SFB returned no-market-data on a 'verified' line).
P1 fcf omits PP&E capex when dev is capitalized (PRIC-B overstated 34%): use CFO - TOTAL investing capex; wc_fcf flag must look back 4 quarters (FY25 CFO was 35% WC release, flag said false).

P2 ebit_trend is trough-anchored (8.66x that is simultaneously 0.50x of the last normal year): also compute vs MAX trailing EBIT in window; flag trough_anchored when current <0.75x peak; backlog/book-to-bill <1.0 must force durability_suspect.

P2 FX-translation guard: where the AR discloses a COGS currency split, compute constant-currency EBIT; flag fx_driven_margin when FX >50% of the margin delta (the PRIC-B mechanism, generalizes across the non-USD shelf).

P2 flow_months=1 read as freshness is actually max catalyst-staleness: add days_since_last_report + post-print cooling window (PRIC-B sourced 13 sessions after a +36% re-rate on the sourcing report itself).
P2 ADV: use MEDIAN daily turnover not mean (SFPI 90k mean vs 51k median, spike-inflated).
bank_consolidation_scanner.py: P1 FRESHNESS GATE: latest 8-K item 2.02 must POSTDATE the financial snapshot or the name is flagged STALE_INPUTS (RVSB scored on 3/31 data while the 7/28 print that resolved the thesis sat 5 days old in EDGAR).
P2 CRE/RBC: compute the regulatory non-owner-occ basis (LNRECONS+LNREMULT+LNRENROT), not the upper bound (442% -> 350% on RVSB); keep both.
P2 loss-decomposition hint: when NI<0, check for securities-restructuring 8-K language (HTM->AFS reclass) — an accretive loss is a different animal; auto-annotate.
spinoff_orphans.py: P1 DOCTRINE: spin-offs have NO underwriter quiet period — coverage initiates day 1 of regular-way. Any initiation-wave-at-25-40d catalyst is FABRICATED; remove from playbook, re-rank the late-window cohort.
P2 recovery_off_trough_pct from closes only hides intraday bounce-and-fade (+26% intraday invisible); add intraday range leg.
P2 SOLS setup_class vs doctrine contradiction (flagged by court, unresolved).

P2 process: for any spin, pull the PRE-SPIN INVESTOR DAY DECK alongside the Form 10 — management guidance (organic growth, standalone costs, leverage target, capital-return) is NOT in EDGAR (MBGL: missed +$20-25M run-rate costs, $75-100M one-time, ~$1B IHS DTL).
ai_adopter_smallcap: P1 bank_holdco_ratio_denominator guard: never fire a cost-out detector on X/Revenue for SIC 6022 / any registrant with an ALCO table — require the numerator tested vs FEE revenue and absolute dollars (CASS: Labor/Rev improved while Labor/FeeRev worsened on the same audited inputs).
P1 onetime_base_effect_inflation: screen the PRIOR 4-quarter window for discrete items before computing any delta-margin (77% of the CASS 'inflection' was base rolloff).

P1 disclosure_recency_gate: an absence-of-disclosure archetype must re-check ALL venues incl 8-Ks to the cutoff (CASS 'zero AI disclosure' was refuted by an 8-K 11 days before intake; signal-to-price latency ~7 sessions, already elapsed).

euronext_shelf.py P1 PENSION GUARD.how: _map_facts now reads 'Long Term Provisions' (yfinance carries no explicit pension tag for European filers) and folds it into the debt slot so EV and net-cash inherit it everywhere downstream; _pension_is_proxy + _pension_note flag that provisions OVER-capture (warranty/restructuring/litigation) and the IAS-19 split must be read before sizing
euronext_shelf.py P1 PENSION GUARD.VALIDATION: SFPI net cash 39% -> 13.4% of market cap. The court, reading the annual report by hand, said 39% -> 12-18%. The automated guard lands inside the court's band.
euronext_shelf.py P1 PENSION GUARD.shelf_wide_effect: BAR.BR -EUR18.9M, TFI.PA -EUR24.7M — this is a systematic correction across the DE/FR/Nordic industrial shelf, not a one-name patch

ai_adopter P1 x3.G1_mix_regression: from the CRVL court; constant-intensity fit with no productivity term. Returns UNKNOWN (not PASS) when the store lacks segment revenue — an untested gate is not a passed gate
ai_adopter P1 x3.G2_alco_denominator: resolved from the registrant's OWN XBRL companyfacts rather than a name heuristic. NARROWED after a false positive: 'Deposits' catches any company holding customer funds (PHR processes patient payments), so the tag set is now four spread-lender-only tags
ai_adopter P1 x3.G3_base_effect: uses the store's 8-quarter margin series; replaces the prior window's worst quarter with its median and re-measures. A >100% share is reported as a SIGN REVERSAL (PAYC: +0.44pp becomes -1.64pp ex-outlier = there is no inflection, only a weak base)
ai_adopter P1 x3.G4_disclosure_recency: fires on the absence-of-disclosure archetype using named_ai_cost_program
ai_adopter P1 x3.RESULT_ON_80_NAMES: 33 BLOCKED, 47 UNRESOLVED, 0 CLEAR. Of the original top-8 intake: PAYC/MMS/STC BLOCKED on base effect, CRVL/CASS/ALIT/HQY/PHR UNRESOLVED pending segment data.
